source: Israel Planning Administration + Government Urban Renewal Authority, via mitar.co.il
totals_note_he: נכון ל-2026-11-09: 1,598 פרויקטים בערים שבקובץ, מתוך 1,606 במאגר. 8 רשומות משויכות ליישוב שאין לו עמוד עיר באתר.

cities.name: ירושלים
cities.projects_in_execution_basis: The Urban Renewal Authority's Bebitzua flag. It is set only while permits cover part of a complex's units; a complex with permits for every unit is not marked, so it is not a completion rate.
cities.units_basis: registry rows only; reports read off publications are not summed
cities.median_deposit_to_approval_basis: Plans with both a deposit date (Xplan pl_date_advertise) and a gazette approval date (pl_date_8). Xplan fills the deposit date for most district-committee plans and almost no local-committee plans, so this is mostly the district-committee track. approved_without_deposit counts the approved plans it leaves out.
